title: Property Classification Schema Extension
description: Extended Prisma schema with comprehensive property classification system. Added PropertyCategory, PropertySubcategory, PropertyType, PropertyConfiguration, PropertyUsageType, and PropertyInvestmentType models with proper relations. Supports multi-language labels, validation rules, display ordering, icons, and active status flags.
features: Proper foreign key relations and cascades
Updated Inventory model to reference new classification models
result_summary: Complete schema extension for property classification system. Added 6 new models with full support for multi-language labels, validation rules, display ordering, and active status management. Foundation ready for comprehensive property taxonomy.
